target_definition: Monthly gross profit / gross loss >= 1.20 in at least 60% of active training months and 50% of active holdout months; aggregate PF >= 1.20 in both windows.
method: Chronological training/holdout split is aligned to realized exit months so a multi-session position cannot spill across the validation boundary. Predeclared lagged index indicator and regime signals choose between same-date, same-expiry, same-strike ATM Call/Put outcomes and bounded-risk ATM debit vertical spread outcomes for one-, two-, three- and five-session holds. Debit spreads require both observed legs at entry and exit, and reject inverted spread marks. Option outcomes are rebuilt from observed BSE daily candles, with the exact same contract held through the selected exit session. A missing side is not fabricated; that direction is skipped when its observed quote is unavailable. Signals use only the last completed index session before entry. Candidate rules are ranked using training only; holdout is separate. Rolling selectors use only prior complete calendar months.
selector_note: Rolling selector is a paper-research allocation rule only. It goes to cash when no signal has at least 20 prior trades and prior-window PF >= 1.20.
caveat: This is a historical screening experiment, not a live profit guarantee. Option outcomes use one-lot EOD marks and estimated costs; intraday execution, queue position and slippage may differ. Repeated research iterations create selection bias, so any promising rule needs a new prospective paper-trading period before live deployment.
